args.query: Is the Logitech G PRO Racing Wheel compatible with PS3?

resolver.draft: Hi Suresh Kumar, thank you for reaching out. The Logitech G PRO Racing Wheel is designed for PC and supported consoles, but it is not compatible with the PS3. If you have any other questions or need further assistance, feel free to ask!
